about: Who does what (Brett, Nov 9 2026: "Assign employees to every single type of action and app, so I can understand easily what's what"). Every job in the system has one employee on the crew who holds it: the orchestrator and its dispatcher, each app, each kind of action. `holder` is the default; Brett reassigns from Breakroom → Who does what (kept in the plugin's data folder, never here). `match` says which Activity Monitor entries are the role's: an entry whose `by` names a crew member is theirs; otherwise the first role (top to bottom) whose ids / sources / kinds / words fit it. `fallback` takes anything nothing else matches.
